test_ReadFromTFDS: test the beam_utils.ReadFromTFDS function to read TFDS examples into an Apache Beam pipeline with configurable split and workers_per_shard
test_ReadFromTFDS_batch_size: test the beam_utils.ReadFromTFDS function with batch_size parameter to verify subsplit splits raise NotImplementedError
test_inc_counter: test the beam_utils.inc_counter function to increment Beam metrics counters with custom name, value, and namespace
test_ReadFromTFDS_workers_per_shard: test the beam_utils.ReadFromTFDS function with varying workers_per_shard values to verify parallel shard processing
test_ReadFromTFDS_subsplit: test the beam_utils.ReadFromTFDS function with subsplit syntax like train[:2] and train[1:] to verify correct example selection
